ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 cancellation fee; inform the rider the fee is valid under the published cancellation policy (cancel >3 min after matching); no refund or voucher.

rejected_claims.reason: Rider's claim that the fee is unfair because the driver had not arrived — Ryde publishes no ETA-based free-cancellation rule; the rider's own cancellation was 6 min 40 s after matching, exceeding the 3-minute grace period under NS-4.
Rider's claim that changed plans justify a waiver — change of plans is not one of the two published grounds for fee waiver / cancellation under NS-0; the fee stands.
